note: Sylhet's 0.8° box lies on E039N021T3 (not N024). On typical covering Sunamganj orbits (e.g. 20180606T120436), Sylhet valid_frac is ~0.1% because that SAR swath does not cover Sylhet city. This is footprint mismatch, not a 5% threshold bug and not solved by enlarging the AOI. Neighbor tile E039N024T3 does not contain the AOI. A minority of other orbits (2015-07-11, 2016-01-19) do clip ≥5% valid Sylhet pixels; those are orbit-specific, not a reason to enlarge the box.
